Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full application-status payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Your application status","applicationType":"Building permit","referenceNumber":"APP-2026-1043","status":"review","statusLabel":"Under review","submittedText":"Submitted Sep 3","updatedText":"Updated 2 days ago","steps":[{"label":"Submitted","state":"done","timeText":"Sep 3"},{"label":"Under review","state":"current"},{"label":"Approved","state":"todo"},{"label":"Issued","state":"todo"}],"nextActionText":"We may request additional documents — no action needed right now.","submitText":"Message the office","submitValue":"I'd like to message the office about my application"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): card heading. Defaults to 'Your application status'.
- 'applicationType' (string, optional): what the application is for, e.g. 'Building permit', 'Admission application', 'Benefits case'. Shown under the reference number.
- 'referenceNumber' (string, optional): the case/reference id, shown prominently.
- 'status' (string, REQUIRED): one of submitted | review | approved | issued | denied. Drives the tracker position + the status pill colour. 'denied' renders a terminal Submitted -> Denied track.
- 'statusLabel' (string, optional): human label for the pill, e.g. 'Under review'. Defaults to the status.
- 'submittedText' (string, optional) and 'updatedText' (string, optional): short footer stamps, e.g. 'Submitted Sep 3', 'Updated 2 days ago'.
- 'steps' (array, optional): the progress track. Each { 'label' (string, REQUIRED), 'state' (string — one of done | current | todo | denied), 'timeText' (string, optional — a short date shown under the step) }. If omitted, a default 4-step track (Submitted -> Under review -> Approved -> Issued) is derived from 'status'.
- 'nextActionText' (string, optional): a short callout telling the applicant what happens next or what they must do.
- 'submitText' (string, optional): label for an optional button (e.g. 'Message the office'). 'submitValue' (string, optional): the message sent back to the agent when tapped; defaults to submitText.

Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
